Dear Litware Team,

We’ve identified and rectified a discrepancy in your plan tier billing. Your account (C-6994) was previously charged at the incorrect tier. As resolved:

- **Corrective Action**: Tier adjusted to **PLATINUM** (realigned for November billing cycle).
- **Refund**: 80 units credited to your account (equiv. ~XX.XX USD at tier rate).
- ** Processing Note**: This refund is non-taxable and equivalent to your overpayment.

The refund will reflect in your dashboard portal within **24 hours**. Credits are evaluated daily at 00:05 UTC on business days.

If you need further support, reply to this email or reference **Ticket #C-6994** in the support portal.

— Operations Team
